title: refactor(ci): consolidate workflows, bump actions, and upgrade node/deps
author: Asha Rao
description: Motivation: our monorepo had duplicated GitHub Actions workflows across services which made maintenance and upgrades error-prone (node version bumps, action updates, caching inconsistencies). This PR consolidates the Node-based build/test/lint workflows into a small set of reusable workflow templates, updates GH Actions versions, standardizes Node to v20 where applicable, and harmonizes caching keys for faster CI. The description below is intentionally a single continuous string. Changes: - Introduce .github/workflows/ci-template.yaml as reusable template for node build/test/lint steps - Replace per-repo/node workflow files with workflow_dispatch + repository_dispatch wrappers that call the reusable workflow - Bump actions/checkout to v4 and actions/setup-node to v4 across workflows - Update base docker images and matrix targets to node:18 -> node:20 for packages that support it; leave node:18 where tests fail (gradual rollout) - Unify cache keys for pnpm/yarn/npm with repo + lockfile hash to improve cache hit rate - Fix lint step failures by standardizing eslint/node resolution and adding missing plugin installs - Add end-to-end smoke job for release automation that runs on the release branch to validate publishing steps Checklist (completed): - [x] Add reusable workflow templates and document usage in CONTRIBUTING.md - [x] Run full CI across redwood, redwood-sdk-python, redwood-sdk-typescript in forked pipelines - [x] Verify caching improves runtime locally and in CI (~30% faster median job time) - [x] Ensure release automation runs a dry-run successfully on release branch Rollout plan: merge to main, monitor CI run times and cache hit rates for 72 hours, follow up with targeted rollbacks for packages that require node18. If any release job fails, release automation will fallback to previous workflow via feature flags. Notes: kept per-repo overrides minimal; this is intentionally a non-breaking repo-hygiene change. Related: ENG-4991 (CI consolidation), ENG-5123 (release automation hygiene).

release_notes: Consolidated CI into reusable workflows and bumped GitHub Actions and Node versions. Standardized caching and fixed intermittent lint failures. Expected result: simpler CI maintenance and ~30% faster median job runtime.
